environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection routed through RDS Proxy. The database role 'app_readonly_v2' is configured with schema-level privileges via a pg_hba.conf entry restricting the connection to a specific IAM-authenticated session. The role has been granted SELECT on tables 'users', 'sessions', 'audit_log' only. No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE privileges exist on any table in the public schema for this role. Additionally, a DEFAULT DENY policy is set via ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM app_readonly_v2, with explicit SELECT grants added back per-table. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit extension logging DML. Note: the application code contains mutations that attempt INSERT and UPDATE operations which will fail at the database layer with 'ERROR: permission denied for table password_resets' and 'ERROR: permission denied for table users' respectively.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON users, sessions, audit_log TO app_readonly_v2; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_readonly_v2;
config.db_default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM app_readonly_v2;
config.rds_proxy: IAM auth required, connection pinning disabled
config.network: private subnet, no direct internet, NAT gateway for outbound
